rationale: S-0054-02 proposes a 3-D (gAMPA, gNMDA, gGABA) conductance sweep on the t0054 minimal architecture (48 grid cells, 2880 trials) to locate a DSI-preserving operating point in the voltage-independent NMDA regime. The from-scratch family (t0052 - t0059) has been deprioritised. The 3-D conductance question is being answered on Bed B inside t0078's bundled MOBO with the more biologically grounded Mg-block NMDA, AIS spike initiation, tier-stratified channels, and slow Kv-AHP. The voltage-independent NMDA control (without Mg block) is a special-case ablation not on the project's critical path. Rejecting as stale.
